title: CSS standards inventory
scope: Bounded standards discovery: CSS Snapshot 2026 sections 2.1–2.4, the requested 2025 classification, W3C CSS descriptions/current-work tables, CSSWG editor-draft index, selected linked CSS/Houdini/API specs and necessary adjacent standards. This is a module/requirement-family inventory and executable package plan, not an exhaustive recursive crawl, clause-level conformance certificate, property-completion claim or current ChezCat support report.

classification_policy.publication: Current successfully retrieved TR header, separate from snapshot tier
classification_policy.csswg_index: Current-work page grouping and status preserved even when stale
classification_policy.editor_draft: Separately recorded; does not imply consensus, publication or interoperable implementation
classification_policy.adoption: unknown unless verified at feature level; snapshot maturity is not browser adoption
classification_policy.unknown: Null/unknown means unverified, never absent support or absence of a standard

duplicate_classification_removed: css-cascade-5 removed from rough interoperability; remains reliable-CR
delta_2025_to_2026.unchanged_section_membership: Official-definition, reliable-CR and fairly-stable groups retain their module membership in the inspected classifications.
new_pre_cr_exception_groups: env() and safe-area inset variables (snapshot spelling contains 'save-area'; use module spelling)
delta_2025_to_2026.other_exception_change: Animations 1/Transitions 1 remain safe-to-release exceptions; 2025 labels them retroactive separately, 2026 includes them in the single list.
delta_2025_to_2026.boundary: Comparison is of inspected classification/exception/section scope; it is not a normative text diff of all linked specs.

forward_items.state: planned gated feature work; no shipping claim
forward_items.work: Freeze the exact delta; enumerate each new grammar, property, algorithm, interface, invalidation edge and security/privacy requirement; implement one coherent feature slice after integration prerequisites.
forward_items.native_acceptance: Provide an independently derived algorithm/value/error oracle and bounded-resource adversarial cases for the chosen feature.
forward_items.browser_acceptance: Demonstrate the chosen feature through ChezCat layout/paint/input or original-runtime API tests, plus a disabled-feature fallback control; record unavailable harness prerequisites as blocked.
forward_items.promotion_gate: Per-feature standards/adoption review and native+browser evidence; retain unchanged failure counts and explicit unsupported remainder.
forward_items.prerequisite_policy: Select actual core and integration interfaces for the chosen feature at admission. Candidate owners are discovery hints, not whole-package prerequisites.
